info.title: Outbound webhook receiver
info.description: What an endpoint registered for outbound webhooks receives. Each delivery is one POST of a CloudEvents 1.0 structured event, signed per Standard Webhooks v1. The event is a nudge: it names the record, and the receiver reads the record through the API with its own key. Deliveries are at least once: the same event can arrive more than once, always with the same webhook-id, so a receiver must deduplicate on webhook-id. Any 2xx acknowledges a delivery; anything else, or no answer within 10 seconds, is retried after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 2 hours and 12 hours. Redirects are not followed. The URL is the endpoint's registered URL, which must be https on port 443.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: The event's id. The same on every attempt and every redelivery of one event: deduplicate on it.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: When this attempt was signed, in Unix seconds. Reject a timestamp more than five minutes from your clock.

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: v1, then the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of webhook-id, '.', webhook-timestamp, '.', and the raw body, keyed by the base64-decoded part of the endpoint's whsec_ secret. Compare in constant time.

id.description: The audit event id; equal to webhook-id.

subject.description: The id of the record the event is about.

id.description: The record's id. Nothing else of the record is sent.

default.description: Not acknowledged: retried on the schedule above.
